exec: pm.test('items array and cache state returned', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(['HIT','MISS','DISABLED']).to.include(j.cache); });
pm.test('25 unique IDs', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(25); pm.expect(j.unique_in_batch).to.eql(true); pm.expect(new Set(j.ids).size).to.eql(25); });
pm.test('three or more nodes and virtual nodes', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.nodes).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(j.virtual_nodes_per_shard).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('required component metric groups exist', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); ['rate_limiter','key_value_store','consistent_hashing','id_generator','url_shortener','crawler'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(j).to.have.property(k)); });

const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('email matches generated test account', () => pm.expect(j.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email'))); pm.test('role is student', () => pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('STUDENT'));
pm.test('student role forbidden from staff action', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
